name: BlackStar Enterprise Group, Inc.
summary: BlackStar Enterprise Group, Inc. (BEGI), in conjunction with its subsidiary companies, functions as a merchant banking firm. Its main role involves channeling venture capital into nascent, revenue-generating businesses throughout the United States, with a growing focus on blockchain and distributed ledger technology (DLT). Originally incorporated in 2007 under the name BlackStar Energy Group, Inc., the company officially rebranded to BlackStar Enterprise Group, Inc. in September 2016. Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, BlackStar Enterprise Group, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of International Hedge Group, Inc.
